command:
set -euo pipefail; TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/omega-qwen-json.XXXXXX); PID=''; cleanup(){ if [ -n "${PID:-}" ]; then kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; rm -rf "$TMP"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; export OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11436; ollama serve >"$TMP/server.log" 2>&1 & PID=$!; for i in $(seq 1 40); do ollama list >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 0.5; done; set +e; ollama run qwen2.5:0.5b --format json 'Return one JSON object only with keys summary,facts,keywords,entities,open_questions. Facts, keywords, entities, open_questions must be arrays. Summarize: OMEGA UnifiedDB source data enters through canonical GRID10.' >"$TMP/out" 2>"$TMP/err"; RC=$?; set -e; echo RC=$RC; echo OUT_BEGIN; cat "$TMP/out"; echo; echo OUT_END; echo ERR_BEGIN; tail -30 "$TMP/err"; echo ERR_END; test $RC -eq 0; python3 - "$TMP/out" <<'PY'
import json,sys
o=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert isinstance(o,dict); assert 'summary' in o; print('JSON_PARSE_PASS=1 keys='+','.join(sorted(o)))
PY
echo OMEGA_QWEN_JSON_MODE_PASS=1
